title: Cowboys spoil comeback bid with TDs at end of each half in Colts’ 5th straight loss

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cowboys spoil comeback bid with TDs at end of each half in Colts’ 5th straight loss
sources.description: The Indianapolis Colts fought their way back from down 10 in the second half and took control late in the fourth quarter, but the thrill of stealing a comeback win was short-lived as Dak Prescott led the Dallas Cowboys on a game-winning touchdown drive inside the final minute to escape with a 27-23 win.
